whyItWorks.mechanism: Suggestive POV narrative leveraging a common fantasy trope combined with an attractive subject.
retentionDrivers: The visual reveal of the subject
The anticipation of where she is going
The direct eye contact and suggestive gesture at the end
whyItWorks.targetViewer: Male audience, users interested in POV/skit content, users drawn to attractive subjects.
whyItWorks.shareCommentTrigger: The relatable text overlay contrasting with the highly unlikely/fantasy scenario.

workarounds: Film on a bus or train during off-peak hours
Use a narrow hallway with chairs lined up to simulate an aisle

mustKeep: Text overlay setting a mundane context
Subject walking away down a narrow corridor
Subject turning back to make a suggestive gesture before entering a room
swappable: Airplane setting (could be a train, bus, or office)
